name: Xingfu de Errenfang
source:
I've been kidnapped.
Kidnapped by a sister I have known for many years ...

What is a right choice? No matter what you think and how you choose, you will eventually come to a desperate situation.But she told me —
It doesn't matter if you choose a wrong path. Just do your best and it will turn out right.

Towards the end of the summer, while I was suffocating under the weight of life, I saw her again.
I told her all the sufferings I had undergone in the last four years, how I had even wanted to leave the world behind at one point...
She took my hand and led me to a new life.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1897120/Happiness_Double_Room/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我被绑架了。
被认识多年的姐姐绑架了……

什么是正确的选择？不管你怎么想，怎么选择，最终都会陷入绝境。但她告诉我——
即使你选择了错误的道路也没有关系。只要尽力而为，结果就会是正确的。

夏末，当我在生活的重压下快要窒息的时候，我又见到了她。
我告诉她这四年来我所经历的一切苦难，我什至一度想离开这个世界……
她牵着我的手，带领我走向新的生活。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1897120/Happiness_Double_Room/]Steam[/url]]
